remake.cast: exactly one human man (black hoodie) and exactly one dog (the Shiba) - no other people or animals
remake.swap: the yellow Labrador in the yard becomes the Shiba Inu from image 1 (the same Shiba in every frame, thick furry legs, round paws); the man in the black hoodie climbing the fence stays a real human man with the same black hoodie, black trousers, hood up, face hidden by the hood, human hands, and exactly the same actions
board_notes: Vertical 9:16 security-camera view of a sunny backyard: a tall wooden plank fence runs across the middle, an apple tree heavy with red apples overhangs the fence from behind, dirt and dry-grass ground with a round tree stump at front-left, hard daylight. 0.5s: the man in a black hoodie (hood up, black trousers) is straddling the top of the fence, swinging a leg over to climb into the yard; the Shiba stands on the ground below looking up at him, ears up.

Vertical 9:16 security-camera view of a sunny backyard: a tall wooden plank fence runs across the middle, an apple tree heavy with red apples overhangs the fence from behind, dirt and dry-grass ground with a round tree stump at front-left, hard daylight. 1.5s: the man has landed and stands by the fence facing the Shiba; the Shiba stands facing him, relaxed, tail up and wagging.

Vertical 9:16 security-camera view of a sunny backyard: a tall wooden plank fence runs across the middle, an apple tree heavy with red apples overhangs the fence from behind, dirt and dry-grass ground with a round tree stump at front-left, hard daylight. 2.1s: the man bends and pats the Shiba's head with one hand; the Shiba leans into the hand happily, eyes soft, tail wagging.

Vertical 9:16 security-camera view of a sunny backyard: a tall wooden plank fence runs across the middle, an apple tree heavy with red apples overhangs the fence from behind, dirt and dry-grass ground with a round tree stump at front-left, hard daylight. 3.0s: the man reaches up with both arms, pulling an apple-laden branch down and picking red apples; the Shiba stands beside him watching calmly.

Vertical 9:16 security-camera view of a sunny backyard: a tall wooden plank fence runs across the middle, an apple tree heavy with red apples overhangs the fence from behind, dirt and dry-grass ground with a round tree stump at front-left, hard daylight. 5.2s: the man is climbing back over the fence, one leg over the top, hoodie pocket bulging with apples; the Shiba stands below watching him leave, tail wagging.

Vertical 9:16 security-camera view of a sunny backyard: a tall wooden plank fence runs across the middle, an apple tree heavy with red apples overhangs the fence from behind, dirt and dry-grass ground with a round tree stump at front-left, hard daylight. 7.4s: the Shiba alone in the yard, sniffing the ground by the fence then glancing toward the camera, tail wagging; only the man's leg is disappearing over the fence at the top-left; apples still hang above.

gags.text: the man in the black hoodie climbs over the wooden fence from behind the apple tree and drops into the yard while the Shiba looks up at him
the man bends forward and pats and strokes the Shiba's head; the Shiba leans in and wags its tail, friendly, no barking
the man reaches up with both arms, pulls an apple-laden branch down and picks red apples, tucking them into his hoodie; the Shiba stands beside him watching calmly

gags.en: climbs back out with the apples
gags.text: the man turns, grabs the top of the fence and climbs back over it and out of sight; the Shiba just watches, tail wagging
the Shiba alone sniffs the ground where the man stood, then turns and looks toward the camera, tail wagging as if nothing happened

remake.ending: Same backyard by the wooden fence, same daylight and security-camera angle, the thief is gone. The Shiba sits calmly in front of the fence with the real dog apple-juice product (image 2) standing upright on the ground beside it, lapping apple juice from a small bowl next to the bottle, tail wagging, red apples still hanging above
remake.big: 사과 도둑을 그냥 보내 준 경비견
remake.vo: 사과는 드릴게요. 주스는 제 거라서. 구매는 프로필 링크에서.
